messages:
Maya: Idea for private setup scan UI: show a priority strip that lists top 3 issues (high->low) with short one-line fixes, hide full logs under an expand. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Devon: +1. Top-3 focus reduces cognitive load. Add a tiny copy button on each strip.

Alex: We'll need structured probe output (check_id, severity, title, brief_fix, raw_log_url). Current probe is plain text, so backend change required.

ops-bot: Probe 2026-04-07T08:21:09Z  results: 21 checks, 2 high, 4 med, 15 ok. raw: https://internal/probes/2175550001/log.txt

Keisha: Microcopy suggestion for a high item: "Agent can't reach registry Quick fix: allow outbound HTTPS (443) from host." Keep it non-technical in the UI.

Jamal: Accessibility: add text labels (Fail/Warn/OK) on chips, aria-live summary when scan completes, and ensure expand buttons have aria-controls and visible focus. Avoid hiding content with display:none for SR users.

Maya: UX decision: show inline "Why this matters" sentence only for high severity; link to KB for others. This balances clarity and clutter.

Devon: Can we feature-flag the inline sentence so we can measure support contacts?

Alex: Yes. Frontend can toggle. I'll produce API contract by Tue. Need mapping of error_code -> KB slug though.

Keisha: I'll draft the KB mappings and two copy variants (short vs. explanatory) by Monday.

Maya: I'll update Figma and include keyboard nav notes. Will ping for sign-off when ready.

Devon: Scheduling a 15m sync Wed 10:30 to agree on API fields and copy. :thumbsup:
